title: LANL Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events
evidence: Observed enterprise event data; access form; not downloaded
schema: De-identified identifiers, relative seconds, authentication outcomes and flows
limitations: Split chronologically and by entity; the small red-team label set is incomplete; absence of a label is not a negative truth. Failed-auth inclusion is conditional on at least one successful auth.
resource_budget: 58 days, approximately 12 GB compressed; plan streaming aggregation rather than full RAM loading
rights: CC0 waiver stated by publisher; human-subject and public-release approvals documented

title: Telemanom SMAP/MSL anomaly data and original study
applicability: Spacecraft anomaly detection; benign operational anomalies do not label cyber compromise
schema: Channel arrays and labeled anomaly intervals; inspect README preprocessing before use
limitations: Hold out channels/time; avoid random overlapping window splits and inflated point-adjusted recall; report per-event as well as per-timestamp scoring.
resource_budget: Array data and Python ecosystem; size and dependencies must be checked at pinned revision
rights: Repository license and dataset terms require review before redistribution

title: CISA KEV issuer-maintained data mirror
evidence: Observed public catalog metadata; 1731 selected records downloaded
applicability: Descriptive catalog timing and owned-inventory relevance
schema: CVE identifier, vendor, product, addition date, ransomware-use indicator
limitations: Snapshot SHA and date; addition date is not exploitation onset; missing KEV membership does not mean unexploited. No exploit descriptions or target records are included.
rights: CC0 per issuer README and LICENSE
inspection: repository and license inspected; pinned source commit in kev_snapshot.json

title: Google Borg cluster and power traces
applicability: Cloud scheduling, resource-budget and correlated workload sensitivity
schema: Task and machine events, usage; 2019 power trace is separately documented
limitations: Temporal and cell holdouts; workload failures are not attacks; job identities and workload mix may not transfer to another environment.
resource_budget: Potentially large trace/query workflow; choose fields and downsample with declared policy
rights: CC-BY per publisher; retain attribution and inspect exact license

title: NIST Computer Forensic Reference Data Sets
schema: Fixture-specific artifacts, hashes, descriptions and truth labels
limitations: Pin fixture and documented truth; tool behavior on one fixture does not establish evidentiary validity in all cases.
rights: Review each dataset terms; portal license is not automatically fixture license
inspection: portal resolved but text not retrievable; fixture contents unverified

title: TLA+ specification examples
evidence: Formal specifications/tool examples; not empirical field data
applicability: Revocation, concurrency, refinement and proof-assumption studies
schema: Specification, configuration, invariants and state bounds
limitations: Document abstraction and fairness; finite model checking is not an unbounded proof; use a separate implementation trace refinement check.
resource_budget: TLC/Java or equivalent; state space can dominate RAM

title: OpenTitan device life-cycle specification
evidence: Hardware design resource; not measured board data
applicability: Firmware recovery and device-state trust review
schema: Declared device states, transition permissions, implementation constraints
limitations: Project-specific architecture; does not validate a derivative device or certify physical fault resistance.
resource_budget: Emulator first; optional owned low-voltage dev board, qualified hardware review
rights: Documentation/source terms require review before copying implementation

title: SLSA specification v1.2
evidence: Versioned provenance requirements; not a labeled dataset
applicability: Artifact identity, source/build provenance and freshness study
schema: Provenance predicate, subject digests, builder and source identity
limitations: Evidence validity differs from software correctness; a claimed level requires all actual evidence requirements.
resource_budget: Owned build artifacts, local verifier, snapshot statements
rights: Follow specification/documentation license and upstream verifier license

title: NASA Core Flight System
evidence: Flight-software architecture resource; not live mission command access
applicability: Offline remote-operation state models and assurance traceability
schema: Framework interfaces, tests, versioned build and configuration
limitations: Do not infer flight readiness or certification from source availability; study command handling and scheduling in an emulator.
resource_budget: Pinned framework checkout and toolchain; submodules separately pinned
rights: Check each component license and export/distribution notes

title: OpenTelemetry documentation
evidence: Instrumentation schemas/tooling; no third-party telemetry downloaded
applicability: Owned-system trace, metric and log correlation
schema: Trace IDs, spans, event time, service/resource attributes and collection loss
limitations: Sampling and asynchronous export create partial observation; exclude secrets and personal attributes from synthetic fixtures.
resource_budget: Optional owned collector and local workload; benchmark supplied here is offline
rights: Review implementation license and data handling separately

title: HELIOS deterministic local fixtures
evidence: Synthetic; generated locally with declared seed 20261002
applicability: Reproducible model mechanics and failure-case evaluation
schema: Six benchmark fixtures, model assumptions, summary, output hashes
limitations: Demonstrates reference algorithms only; neither population realism nor deployed defensive effectiveness follows.
resource_budget: Python standard library; no network or cloud services
rights: New author-generated fixture data; no imported private telemetry
inspection: implemented and tested in this change
